newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wolters buys UK, Spanish publishers.
newsitem.headline: Wolters buys UK, Spanish publishers.

text.p: Dutch publisher Wolters Kluwer NV said on Tuesday it bought UK-based Chapham & Hall Health Science activities from International Thomson Publishing and educational journal Cuadernos de Pedagogia from RBA Revistas in Spain.
Chapman and Hall Health Science activities will become part of Wolters' educational publishing group Stanley Thornes Publishers, which already has healthcare and nursing publishing interests.

"The acquisition is in line with the strategy of Wolters Kluwer to strengthen its educational activities in growth areas in those countries in which the company is already active," the company said in a statement.
In Spain, as well as the purchase of the educational journal, the Wolters Kluwer subsidiary Editorial Praxis has bought IDT S.A., active in tax market books and publisher of "Carta Tributaria".
Wolters gave no financial details of the acquisitions, but said it expected total 1996 sales to be about 4.2 billion guilders.
